users.title: Users
users.description: Every account on the platform, blocked ones included. Roles are moved and accounts are closed from here.
users.emptyDescription: Accounts show up here as soon as somebody signs in for the first time.
users.noResultsDescription: Try another name, or search by role with /role and by status with /status.
users.justificationPlaceholder: Why you are making this change. It is recorded.
users.roleDialogDescription: Pick a role to give it or take it away. Every change is recorded with its reason.
users.roleWillRevoke: The {{role}} role will be taken away from {{name}}.
users.blockDialogDescription: Read what this means before you confirm.
users.blockConsequenceAccess: They will not be able to sign in to the platform again.
users.blockConsequenceData: Their data is kept: their tables, their applications and their history stay as they are.
users.unblockDialogDescription: They will be able to sign in again. The reason is recorded.
users.historyDialogDescription: Every role change and every block, with who made it and why.
users.historyEmptyDescription: Nobody has changed this account's roles or status yet.

errors.ROLE_GRANT_FORBIDDEN: Only an Owner can give or take away the Admin and Owner roles.
errors.CANNOT_BLOCK_PRIVILEGED: An account holding Admin or Owner cannot be blocked.
errors.LAST_OWNER: The platform cannot be left without an Owner. Give the role to somebody else before taking this one away.
errors.CANNOT_REVOKE_OWN_OWNER: You cannot take away your own Owner role. Another Owner has to do it.
errors.generic: We could not apply the change. Try again.

users.roleHelpHint: An admin moves Player and Master; Admin and Owner are moved by an owner only.
users.blockHelpHint: An account holding Admin or Owner cannot be blocked, and neither can your own.

tables.title: Tables to review
tables.emptyDescription: New tables and the ones needing a decision will show up here.
tables.approveConfirmDescription: The table will open so players can apply to it.
tables.requestChangesDialogDescription: Tell the master what to fix before you approve it.
tables.assignMastersDialogDescription: The table opens as soon as it gets a master.
tables.noMastersSelected: You have not picked anybody yet.
tables.mastersOrderHint: The first one you add is the master and the rest are co-masters. Tap a name to make them the master.
tables.createUnassignedDialogTitle: Create a table without a master
tables.createUnassignedDialogDescription: It stays unassigned until you give it a master.
tables.deleteConfirmDescription: It was never published, so it is removed without a trace. This cannot be undone.
